page_summary:
This entry preserves a single-page archived letter by Philip K. Dick, catalogued only as dated to September with no year established. The recipient and the specific contents are not identified in the archive record.

What the item documents is the physical fact of the letter itself: a page of PKD correspondence held in the collection, of the kind that circulated widely among his editors, agents, fellow writers, scholars, and friends. PKD was a prolific and voluble letter-writer, and single pages like this one survive in numbers across archives and private hands.

Without attribution the letter's evidentiary value is documentary rather than interpretive: it is one more surviving artifact of PKD's correspondence, awaiting identification against dated letters and known recipients.
